description: Monero XMR logo — three-layer composition: white background circle, orange upper M-wing, dark grey lower M-notch. Palette groups allow recoloring each layer independently while preserving logo legibility. Opacity controls per-layer transparency.

palette_groups.note: Upper M-wing — canonical Monero orange. Entropy kept low to preserve brand recognizability; slight warm hue drift allowed.
Lower M-notch — canonical dark grey/charcoal. Entropy tight; keeps contrast against orange and background.
Background circle — canonical white. High entropy allows dark or tinted background variants for badge/card contexts.

vars.name: color-bg
vars.note: Background circle fill. Canonical #ffffff. High entropy allows dark/tinted variants.

vars.name: opacity-bg
vars.note: Background circle opacity. Default 1.0; lower for ghost/overlay badge variants.

vars.name: color-primary
vars.note: Upper M-wing fill. Canonical Monero orange #f26822. Low entropy — warm orange band.

vars.name: color-secondary
vars.note: Lower M-notch fill. Canonical dark grey #4d4d4d. Tight entropy — near-neutral dark.
